scope: Read-only review of catalog acceptance determinism, fault injection, crash/restart oracles, and multi-process race coverage.
summary: The r4 P3 is closed. Same-case Start uses a two-stage barrier that proves both processes observed optimistic ready before lock contention; provisioning recovery proves exactly one ready frame/generation and no duplicate transition. No new blocker was found.

closed_findings.evidence: Concurrent provisioning recovery asserts exactly one provisioning-to-ready frame/generation; the other process observes ready without appending a duplicate transition.

reviewed_areas: Two-stage barrier for same-case stale-read Start race
Concurrent provisioning recovery and unique transition/generation
Child-process crash/restart outcomes and side-effect open counters
Write, file Sync, parent-directory Sync, replay, identity, and cleanup faults
Response-loss convergence and test-only golden vectors
limitations: No tests were run; this is a test-design review only.
Windows and POSIX verified-handle, ACL/mode, file-identity, lock-release, and parent-directory durability implementation gates remain mandatory and are not certified by this review.
